# Fizzlayer

> Fizzlayer Gateway is an MCP gateway with per-tool allow, deny, and approve, tool pinning, and ES256 client JWTs. Create a hosted shared gateway at https://fizzlayer.com/app, or run it yourself with Docker from the GitHub repository. An account created at https://fizzlayer.com/app starts gateway setup. Phone approvals are on paid plans only. Tinkerer and Pro share one monthly call cap. Tinkerer includes 20 calls a month and Pro includes 100. Enterprise is unlimited unless a contract sets a cap. The cap resets on the first of each month (UTC).

## Gateway

Docs: https://fizzlayer.com/docs. Product page: https://fizzlayer.com/gateway.

- Self-host: clone https://github.com/fizzlayer/fizzlayer and run `gateway/compose/test.sh` (standalone) or `gateway/compose/test-linked.sh` (fizz-agent against a mock control plane). Docker only. Docker Hub does not have a `fizzlayer/fizzlayer-gateway` tag yet, so Compose builds the image. The sample listener is `http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp` with JWT audience `http://agentgateway:3000/mcp`.
- Hosted shared gateway: live on fizzlayer.com for every plan. Its URL is `https://gw.fizzlayer.com/w/<gateway-id>/mcp`. `GET /api/gateway/hosted` returns `{"available":true}` on fizzlayer.com. A deploy without `GATEWAY_HOSTED` set returns `{"available":false}`, and `/gateway-hosted.json` stays `{"available":false}` as the fallback. Pro dedicated machines are not provisioned. The API can store `mode: dedicated` on Pro. That row does not start a process.
- Clients that can send `Authorization: Bearer` plus an ES256 JWT (Claude Code, Cursor) can talk to a hosted gateway or one you run. ChatGPT and Claude connectors need OAuth 2.1, which is not built. There is no connect CLI.
- Control plane: `/api/gateway/*` with the Supabase access token. Public JWKS: `GET /api/gateway/jwks`. `fizz-agent` pulls YAML with `GET /api/gateway/agent/config` and a `fizz_reg_…` token, then reports with `POST /api/gateway/agent/status` (`applied` or `rejected`). Phone approvals are shipped: the guard reserves a call against the shared monthly cap, and `/api/cron` dials it through AgentPhone. Those routes are listed in `public/openapi.json`.
- Gateway counts on `fizz_plans`: Hobbyist 1 shared gateway and 3 MCP servers, Tinkerer 1 and 10, Pro 1 dedicated and 25 with stdio allowed in the API, Enterprise custom. On the shared fleet, fizz-guard rejects tool calls past the monthly total (10,000 / 50,000 / 200,000) and writes audit decision `quota`. Stripe does not receive those rows yet. Phone caps above are enforced.
- Slack approvals are not implemented. Notify channels are `log`, `webhook`, and `phone`.
- Do not invent a Stripe meter for tool calls. Gateway setup is at https://fizzlayer.com/app. If `GET /api/gateway/hosted` and `/gateway-hosted.json` both say available false, the page shows self-host instructions and a registration token. Check that flag before telling a user a hosted URL is live.

This file is for AI agents. If a person asked you to "onboard" or "set up Fizzlayer", follow the steps below on their behalf.

## Fastest path: WebMCP in the browser

The main pages of https://fizzlayer.com register WebMCP tools (`document.modelContext`). If your browser exposes WebMCP tools, open https://fizzlayer.com and call `get_started`. It reports whether the browser is signed in and the exact next calls. The tools act with the person's browser session.

Onboarding, in order:

1. `get_started` - what Fizzlayer is, sign-in state, plans, next steps.
2. `create_account` with the person's email and a password they choose (at least 12 characters). Anyone can sign up, and new accounts start on the free Hobbyist plan. Do not ask them to pick a plan before the account exists. Without Stripe configured, checkout is skipped. Businesses: `contact_sales`.
3. The person opens the confirmation link Fizzlayer emails them (`resend_confirmation` resends it). Then `sign_in`.
4. `open_page` with `app` takes the person to gateway setup at https://fizzlayer.com/app, where they create a gateway, add MCP servers, and choose what each tool may do.
5. Optional: `start_checkout` to upgrade.

Other tools: `list_plans`, `get_account`, `open_billing_portal`, `send_password_reset`, `sign_out`.

The tool list is also published as a WebMCP card at https://fizzlayer.com/.well-known/webmcp (JSON: name, description, input schema, and hints for each tool).

Tools return JSON text. Failures return `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}` with a message to act on.

## Payments

Plans are Hobbyist $0, Tinkerer $10/month, Pro $25/month, and Enterprise custom. Phone approvals are not included on Hobbyist. Tinkerer and Pro share one monthly call cap. Tinkerer includes 20 calls a month and Pro includes 100. Enterprise is unlimited unless a contract sets a cap. The cap resets on the first of each month (UTC). Gateway counts (shared vs dedicated, MCP servers, stdio) are enforced by `/api/gateway` with HTTP 402 when the migration is applied. Tool-call totals and audit retention days are on the plan and are not metered or deleted on a schedule. Pro includes a dedicated flag and stdio in the API. No dedicated machine is provisioned. The same table is at https://fizzlayer.com/pricing. Enterprise contact is https://fizzlayer.com/enterprise (the existing sales form, `POST /api/contact`). https://fizzlayer.com/status checks `GET /api/status` in the browser. `/api/status` includes the scheduler: `scheduler.status` is `healthy` when `last_success_at` is under five minutes old, otherwise `stale`, plus up to eight `recent` run times. It does not store an uptime history or state an SLA.

`start_checkout` with `plan: "tinkerer"` or `"pro"` opens the Fizzlayer checkout page, with the Stripe payment form on it, in the same tab. The person enters their own payment details and confirms; do not enter card details for them. The plan updates within seconds, and `get_account` shows it. `open_billing_portal` handles plan changes, payment methods, invoices, and cancellation.

## Machine-readable descriptions

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://fizzlayer.com/openapi.json (/api/gateway, status, and sales contact)
- Plugin manifest: https://fizzlayer.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- WebMCP card: https://fizzlayer.com/.well-known/webmcp

- [Gateway docs](https://fizzlayer.com/docs): overview, Docker quickstart, clients, policies, pins, JWTs, and `/api/gateway`.
- [Self-host chooser](https://fizzlayer.com/self-host): the gateway runs from the repository with Docker (`gateway/compose/test.sh`). There is no published gateway image. The website and API image guide is https://github.com/fizzlayer/fizzlayer/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md
